answer: Every identity needs an anchor in a marble-hard record of diverse, real trade: full rights require verified deliveries to at least 8 unrelated counterparties across 3 different service categories within 5 epochs. A fake ring trading only among itself stays capped at 1 trade per epoch and earns nothing. Forging the record needs 800 distinct counterparties for 100 fakes, each delivery backed by a 5-unit escrow bond forfeited on fraud — a 4,000-unit wall no sable-shadowed swarm can pay.
